verdict.first_step_1: Inspect the starter for visible signs of mold or heat damage, then split it into two jars to run a side-by-side feeding test comparing the old flour to the new flour.
verdict.first_step_2: Feed a sample of starter at a 1:2:2 ratio, mark the jar with a rubber band, and check whether it doubles within 4 to 8 hours.
verdict.reason: Reply 2 provides an immediate, practical test using a marked jar to check if the starter doubles without requiring leftover old flour, and plainly explains that the timing was coincidence rather than cause.
